create_dataset_instance: create a Dataset instance for ADE20k or NYUv2 semantic segmentation with configurable image size and split
get_train_batch: get a training batch of resized and padded images with segmentation labels from the dataset
get_test_item: get a test item with multi-scale resized images and original segmentation labels for evaluation
convert_bgr_to_lab: convert a BGR image to LAB color space with normalized L, A, B channel ranges
load_normals_file: load NYUv2 surface normals and valid depth masks from a pickle file for evaluation
